title: Token pricing table
description: USD per 1,000,000 tokens per model, read as data by the local telemetry collectors (C2/C8).

basis.description: What the numbers MEAN. 'list_price_equivalent' = public list prices used as a comparable yardstick, which is what they are whenever the assistants run on subscriptions rather than metered API keys -- in that case nobody is billed these amounts and a budget built on them is a consumption budget, not a spend budget. 'billed' = the org is actually invoiced per token at these rates. Declared in a field, not a comment, so a reader (or a check) can tell the two apart.

governs.description: Plane this config belongs to. Pricing for the assistant workflow is NOT pricing for the shipped product; keep the two apart (see CLAUDE.md, plane separation).

models.description: Keyed by the model id exactly as the assistant reports it.

default.description: Applied to a model absent from `models`. Null rates mean UNPRICED: the collector reports 0 cost and warns, rather than inventing a number.

cached_input.description: Rate for cache READS. Null falls back to the input rate, which OVERSTATES cost — real usage is heavily cached (one measured thread: 93% of input tokens were cache reads).

rate.description: USD per 1M tokens, or null when the rate is genuinely unknown. Null is a first-class value here: a guessed rate that looks plausible is worse than a visible gap (C13/C14).
